AI Assistant

Review the copy in this draft. Does it align with our brand voice?

DV

Worked for 14s

Here’s a quick review based on your Formee Education brand guidelines

Overview

The copy is clear and positive, but some phrases feel generic. Your brand voice is supportive, practical, and student-focused, so the messaging could feel more personal and specific.

Suggestions

1. Replace “Shape Your Future” with “Find the Right Study Path for You” to make the message more specific and student-focused.

2. Change “Get Started” to “Explore Your Options” to create a more supportive, less sales-driven CTA.

3. Avoid broad claims like “World-Class Education” unless they are supported by evidence. Consider “Study Options Designed Around Your Goals” instead.

Make the headline more welcoming
